general: Purchase orders are the orders actually placed with suppliers: what was ordered, from whom, at what price, and what has already been received. In a conversion, open purchase orders represent the deliveries and obligations still to be expected.
Each row is one order line. The order header columns (order number, order date, creditor) repeat on every line of that same order; the other columns describe the ordered item.
The creditors and items you refer to here must also appear in the conversion of the Crediteuren and Artikelen modules.
The columns below are derived from the AFAS specification of the purchase order (UpdateConnector FbPurch). The import template for this module is still to be delivered.

Ordernummer.description: The number of the purchase order from the source system. Lines of the same purchase order carry the same number; that is how AFAS knows which lines belong together. Maximum 12 characters.

Orderdatum.description: The date of the purchase order. No delivery date or due date on the line may fall before this. Format DD-MM-JJJJ or DD/MM/JJJJ.

Crediteur Nummer.description: The creditor number of the supplier. Must match the conversion of the Crediteuren module. Maximum 16 characters.

Omschrijving.description: What the purchase order is about, in one line. Maximum 255 characters.

Administratie.description: The number of the financial administration. Checked against the administration table in the AFAS environment of this project.

Gewenste leverdatum.description: The date on which delivery is wanted. Must not be earlier than the order date. Format DD-MM-JJJJ or DD/MM/JJJJ.

Datum levering toegezegd.description: The delivery date the supplier has promised, when it differs from the wanted date. Leave empty when nothing has been promised. Format DD-MM-JJJJ or DD/MM/JJJJ.

Vervaldatum.description: The date on which the purchase order expires or must be paid. Must not be earlier than the order date. Format DD-MM-JJJJ or DD/MM/JJJJ.

Valuta.description: The currency of the amounts, as a three-character code. Enter EUR for euros. As soon as a currency is entered here, EUR included, the exchange rate is required; for EUR it is 1.

Valutakoers.description: The rate at which the amounts are converted to the base currency. Required as soon as a currency is filled in. For euros it is 1.

Referentie leverancier.description: The reference the supplier uses itself, as it appears on its documents. Maximum 50 characters.

Betalingsvoorwaarde.description: The payment condition. Checked against the payment condition table in the AFAS environment of this project. Leave empty to use the creditor's. Maximum 5 characters.

Automatisch betalen.description: Whether invoices on this order are paid automatically (Ja) or released manually (Nee). With Ja the payment condition is required.

Creditorder.description: Whether this is a credit order (Ja), where goods go back to the supplier, or a regular order (Nee).

Magazijn.description: The warehouse where the goods are received. Leave empty for services or when only one warehouse is used. Maximum 15 characters.

Dagboek factuur.description: The purchase journal in which the invoice for this order is booked. Leave empty to use the default journal of the administration. Maximum 6 characters.

Projectnummer.description: The project the purchasing is charged to. Required when Type projectkosten is filled in. Maximum 15 characters.

Regelnummer.description: The line number within the purchase order, which fixes the order of the lines. Leave empty to use the order in the file. A whole number from 1.

Type item.description: What the line is about: Wst = work type, Art = article, Kst = cost, Sam = composition. Determines how AFAS processes the line.

Itemcode.description: The code of the article, work type, cost type or composition, matching Type item. Checked against the item table in the AFAS environment of this project. Maximum 40 characters.

Omschrijving regel.description: A different description for this line. Leave empty to use the item's standard description. Maximum 255 characters.

Eenheid.description: The unit in which the quantity is expressed, such as pieces, hours or box. Maximum 15 characters.

Aantal eenheden.description: The number of units per order unit — how many are in one box, set or package. Enter 1 when ordering per piece. Not negative.

Aantal ontvangen.description: The quantity already received. Enter 0 for an order on which nothing has been delivered yet. Can never be higher than the quantity ordered — in a conversion of open orders, the difference is exactly what is still expected.

Prijs per eenheid.description: The purchase price per unit, excluding VAT, in the currency of the order. For an order this price is required: without a price the obligation cannot be determined. Not negative.

BTW-tariefgroep.description: The VAT rate group of the line. Leave empty to use that of the item or the creditor. Maximum 4 characters.

Regelkorting percentage.description: The discount percentage on this line. Leave empty or enter 0 when there is no discount. A value between 0 and 100.

Afwijkende afleverdatum.description: A delivery date that applies to this line only. Leave empty when the date in the header applies. Format DD-MM-JJJJ or DD/MM/JJJJ.

Grootboekrekening.description: The general ledger account the costs are booked to. Required on a cost line (Type item Kst), because a cost line without an account cannot be booked. Maximum 16 characters. The tool does not check the number against the chart of accounts; check yourself that the account exists in AFAS.

Type projectkosten.description: The cost type in the project administration: MA = material, A = labour (Arbeid), ME = equipment (Materieel), OA = subcontracting (Onderaanneming), O = other (Overig). Only to be used with a project.
